name: Power MOSFET (IRLZ44N)
description: A big N-channel MOSFET in a TO-220 package for switching motors, LED strips and solenoids from an Arduino pin. IRLZ44N is "logic level": a 5 V gate turns it fully on (about 0.025 Ω), so it barely warms up. The IRF520 needs about 4 V on the gate and is weaker at 5 V. Wire: S to GND, load between the supply and D, the pin to G through 100–220 Ω, a 10kΩ pull-down from G to GND, and a flyback diode across a motor or coil. PWM (analogWrite) controls the speed.
